author: DjectStudio
description: Search 1,161 icons in 4 styles and get SVG, React or data URI code. Hosted MCP server, free icons need no key.
name: Neat Icons

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search Neat Icons (1161 icons, 4 styles, 24px grid). Use plain words for what the icon shows ("wallet", "arrow left", "hijri calendar"). Returns icon names to pass to get_icon. Each result says free: true or false. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code; the rest need a license (https://neaticons.com/#pricing).

query.description: What the icon should show, e.g. 'delete', 'saudi riyal', 'user add'

category.description: Optional category id or title from list_categories

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All Neat Icons categories with their id and icon count.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: One icon as ready-to-paste code. format svg = SVG markup, jsx = a React component, data-uri = for CSS or . Default color currentColor so it follows the text color. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code; the rest need a license (https://neaticons.com/#pricing).

name.description: Exact icon name from search_icons, e.g. 'wallet'

style.description: rounded-stroke (default, calm UI), rounded-solid (selected / active), sharp-stroke, sharp-solid

color.description: Any CSS color; keep currentColor to inherit

animated.description: true = the icon's hover animation. format svg returns inline SVG with its own

tools.name: get_icons
tools.description: Several icons at once (same style, size, color, format). Use for nav bars, tab bars, menus. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code; the rest need a license (https://neaticons.com/#pricing).

style.description: rounded-stroke (default, calm UI), rounded-solid (selected / active), sharp-stroke, sharp-solid

animated.description: true = the icon's hover animation. format svg returns inline SVG with its own
